>         /// <summary>The minimum number of iterations for a loop, or the capture group number for a capture or backreference.</summary>

I know this wasn't introduced here, but is there a reason why not to have separate properties for loops vs captures? Especially since defaults are different. One benefit of separating them is that we can then rename them to more accurately describe what they represent.

---
Refers to: src/libraries/System.Text.RegularExpressions/src/System/Text/RegularExpressions/RegexNode.cs:33 in 4f55002. [](commit_id = 4f55002fbb8152f606537c8ed692aab54aabdb61, deletion_comment = False)

> is there a reason why not to have separate properties for loops vs captures?

We'd still want shared fields for size reasons, but if we wanted to give those fields multiple names for clarity at consumption sites, we could have multiple properties get/set'ing the same fields. I'm not sure it's worth it, but if you think it'd be helpful, please feel free to submit a PR for it after this goes in.

> I can add these docs later as well.

Sounds good, thanks.
